metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the game forgot to check if I was aiming LOL
metadata.description:
Clicked randomly and boom, enemy down.
They’re probably uninstalling just to rethink life.
Click if your aim’s broke but the game loves you anyway.
Watch me pretend this was all skill for 2 secs.

Tap if your aim’s a mess but luck’s got your back!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
